pages.text: Wild Aggression is a status effect that makes affected Dragons hostile towards nearby Players for the effects duration. $(br2)Dragons aggravated this way can't be calmed down using Dragon Nip or by abiding by their taming requirements.
pages.title: Basic Information

pages.text: When a Dragon initially acquires the Wild Aggression Effect they become hostile to any nearby Players, and the affected dragon remains hostile for the duration of the effect.
pages.title: Effect Information
